name: AELDARI: PHOENIX LORD FUEGAN
description: Fuegan has dedicated himself to the destruction of the enemies of the Asuryani, and the trail of corpses he has left in his wake spans the galaxy. Those foes he sets his fiery gaze upon are either eradicated from existence with burning blasts from his firepike, Searsong, or cut apart by furious blows from the Fire Axe.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds Fuegan – the legendary Phoenix Lord of the Fire Dragons Aspect Warriors – for use in your Aeldari armies in games of Warhammer 40,000. As with the warriors of the Aspect shrine he founded, he specialises in taking on the toughest targets or amoured assets using overwhelming melta energy. Unleash his burning fury and bring excruciating death to his foes.</br></br>This kit contains 18 plastic components, and 1x Citadel 40mm Round Base. This miniature is supplied unassembled and unpainted – we recommend Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
